fixture.repository: one temporary repository, one file, linear history
fixture.isolation: own HOME and GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL; no network

methodology.statistic: median across runs, with the observed range in each note
methodology.caveat: A short repeated run on one machine, not a soak test. Every measurement names the processes it covers; nothing here is a 24-hour figure or a claim about other hardware.

measurements.name: cold-start-to-ready
measurements.processScope: refyard CLI process: spawn → listener up → readiness object printed (Git feature probe included)
measurements.notes: Includes the doctor-style Git feature probe at startup; excludes building the fixture. median of 3 runs, range 0.437–0.439.

measurements.name: service-rss-after-start
measurements.processScope: the refyard service process only (ps -o rss), after readiness and before any read
measurements.memoryMetric: resident set size of that process, as reported by ps
measurements.notes: Excludes the browser and excludes any Git process. median of 3 runs, range 95.063–96.016.

measurements.name: status-read-throughput
measurements.processScope: one refyard service process over loopback HTTP; each read runs `git status --porcelain=v2 --branch -z` plus the index read
measurements.notes: At concurrency 4 against a 100000-commit repository on this machine. median of 3 runs, range 199.203–207.469.

measurements.name: service-rss-after-reads
measurements.processScope: the refyard service process only, after the read batch above
measurements.memoryMetric: resident set size of that process, as reported by ps
measurements.notes: After 100 reads at concurrency 4. median of 3 runs, range 102.75–103.703.

measurements.name: history-first-page
measurements.processScope: one refyard service process: `git log` for one page, parsed into commit summaries
measurements.notes: Page size 100 of 100000 commits; the response is bounded by the contract's page limit (truncated in 3 of 3 runs). median of 3 runs, range 373–385.

measurements.name: diff-large-file
measurements.processScope: a second refyard service process, one repository with uncommitted changes: one `git diff` of a 8000-line file, parsed into hunks
measurements.notes: Every patch line delivered (16000 of 16000; the run fails if a run delivers fewer), and the response also carries every changed path's metadata. The same patch as git prints it is 813 KiB; the response is 1518 KiB, because each line travels as a {kind,text,noNewline} object. median of 3 runs, range 116–118.

measurements.name: diff-large-file-payload
measurements.processScope: the same response as diff-large-file, measured as the bytes on the wire
measurements.notes: This is the number a streaming design would move, not remove: a browser parses these bytes either way. Almost half of it is the per-line JSON envelope rather than file content. median of 3 runs, range 1554484–1554484.

measurements.name: graceful-shutdown
measurements.processScope: the first service process: SIGTERM to exit, with no request in flight
measurements.notes: After a full read batch and a diff batch on other services. The bounded drain window applies only when a request is in flight, so this is the floor. median of 3 runs, range 4–4.

measurements.name: diff-large-file-second-read
measurements.processScope: the same read again, immediately, against the same service (cache warm)
measurements.notes: Compared with diff-large-file this is what the service's read cache is worth, not what Git costs. median of 3 runs, range 107–108.

measurements.name: diff-long-line
measurements.processScope: a second refyard service process: one `git diff` of a single 700000-character line
measurements.notes: The minified-file shape: one line with no newlines to split on, carried complete (2 patch lines for a single line, 1367 KiB of patch text). median of 3 runs, range 108–110.

measurements.name: diff-long-line-payload
measurements.processScope: the same response as diff-long-line, measured as the bytes on the wire
measurements.notes: One 700000-character line, both sides of the rewrite: 1367 KiB of patch text. No hunk can be streamed line by line here — the unit a streaming design would hand over is either this whole line or an offset into it. median of 3 runs, range 1442557–1442557.

measurements.name: diff-many-files
measurements.processScope: a second refyard service process: one diff request covering 150 changed files
measurements.notes: Per-file share is in the note's first number divided by 150 (0.47 ms each). median of 3 runs, range 70–71.

measurements.name: diff-many-files-payload
measurements.processScope: the same response as diff-many-files, measured as the bytes on the wire
measurements.notes: Across 150 files, i.e. 282 bytes per file. median of 3 runs, range 42374–42374.

measurements.name: diff-truncated-patch
measurements.processScope: a second refyard service process: one `git diff` whose patch crosses the per-file bound, answered bounded
measurements.notes: The service delivered 19995/19995/19995 of 64000 patch lines and reported the response truncated in every run (asserted above): a bounded answer, not a failure. The complete patch is 3.2 MB of patch text. The response names no limit — that string is computed and dropped (see the note in plan 0003's R2). median of 3 runs, range 129–133.

measurements.name: diff-truncated-patch-payload
measurements.processScope: the same response as diff-truncated-patch, measured as the bytes on the wire
measurements.notes: What one bounded path costs on the wire, against the 3.2 MB patch git produces for it with nothing in the way. median of 3 runs, range 1962008–1962008.

measurements.name: diff-service-rss-after-start
measurements.processScope: the second refyard service process only, before any diff was read
measurements.memoryMetric: resident set size of that process, as reported by ps
measurements.notes: The baseline for the batch below; it serves the diff fixture, not the 100000-commit one. median of 3 runs, range 95.25–95.641.

measurements.name: diff-service-rss-after-batch
measurements.processScope: the second refyard service process only, after the diff batch above
measurements.memoryMetric: resident set size of that process, as reported by ps
measurements.notes: Growth over diff-service-rss-after-start: 111.5 MiB for a batch that read a complete ~2 MB patch, a bounded one, a long line, and every changed path's metadata. median of 3 runs, range 204.578–209.797.

measurements.name: status-after-switching-services
measurements.processScope: two refyard service processes: a status read against the first, immediately after the second one answered
measurements.notes: A sequential status read on the first service measured in the same position was 26 ms, so this number is what talking to a different process costs. median of 3 runs, range 18–22.
